description: Applies license changes to many users across many tenants in one call. The body is a JSON array; entries are grouped by tenantFilter internally, so a single call may span tenants.

schema.description: One entry per user. Entries are grouped by tenantFilter before execution.

tenantFilter.description: Target tenant: the tenant's default domain, its tenant ID, or 'AllTenants'.

userIds.description: User object IDs. Only the first entry is acted on per request object.

LicenseOperation.description: Which license change to perform for this entry.

RemoveAllLicenses.description: Strip every license from the user.

ReplaceAllLicenses.description: Replace the user's licenses with LicensesToReplace.

Licenses.description: Licenses to add. The backend reads .value off each entry, so these must be objects, not bare SKU ID strings.

LicensesToRemove.description: Licenses to remove. The backend reads .value off each entry.

LicensesToReplace.description: Licenses to replace the current set with. The backend reads .value off each entry.

x-cipp-override-reason: The body is piped through Group-Object -Property tenantFilter, so the element shape is only reachable through a GroupInfo and cannot be resolved from the AST.
